evidence.description: Pin-mux configuration function (600 bytes). Parameters: r0=port (1=A,2=B,4=C,8=D,16=E), r1=pin (0-15), r2=function (0=GPIO,1-5=alt functions). Manipulates GPBFUN @ 0xB0000084 with read-modify-write. 12 callers analyzed.
GPIO read pin function (96 bytes). Parameters: r0=port, r1=pin. Returns: r0=pin state (0 or 1). Reads from GPIOX_PIN register (offset 0x1C from port base).
GPIO write pin function (100 bytes). Parameters: r0=port, r1=pin, r2=value (0=clear, non-zero=set). Reads/writes GPIOX_DOUT register (offset 0x18 from port base).
